note: Gold for Chip 'n Dale - Rescue Rangers, held-out A. Written 2026-10-16 from the OCR of the gamesdatabase scan, one row per sentence a person can point at in manuals/pages/ChipnDale. Pages are PDF pages from pdftoppm.

statement_keys.player-select: Choose one or two players; Press START to make your selection.
statement_keys.a-jump: Press A to jump. Press DOWN+A to jump down.
statement_keys.b-pick-throw: Press B to pick up objects; press B while holding to throw right or left; UP+B throws upwards.
statement_keys.pad-duck: Press DOWN to make the character duck down.
statement_keys.three-hearts: Each player starts with three hearts per character.
statement_keys.flowers-50: For every 50 flowers collected, a 1-up star appears.
statement_keys.stars-10: For every 10 stars collected, a 1-up star appears.
statement_keys.acorn-heart: Acorns give an extra heart to the player.
statement_keys.crate-hide: Crates can be used to hide in or throw towards enemies.
